desc: Parse N, M and array A.
Build directed graph edges i → A_i.
Compute SCCs using Kosaraju (iterative to avoid recursion limit).
Contract SCCs: assign component id to each node, build DAG edges between components (deduplicate).
Topologically sort the DAG (build forward adjacency and use Kahn's algorithm).
DP: for each component in topological order (leaves first), compute dp[v][t] = product over children c of (prefix sum of dp[c] up to t). Use prefix sums to compute efficiently in O(M) per child.
Answer = product over all sources (components with in-degree 0) of (sum_{t=1..M} dp[source][t]) mod 998244353.
